qa_pairs.question: What section number covers the introduction to the Body chapter?
qa_pairs.answer: The introduction to the Body chapter is covered in section 41-001.

qa_pairs.question: Which section deals with safety precautions for working on bodies of cars with SRS?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 41-003 covers safety precautions for working on bodies of cars with SRS.

qa_pairs.question: Where can I find information about repairing glass fiber reinforced plastic body parts?
qa_pairs.answer: Information about repairing glass fiber reinforced plastic body parts can be found in section 41-010.

qa_pairs.question: What section covers engine carrier front replacement for four wheel drive vehicles?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 41-101 covers engine carrier, front, right/left partial replacement (with wheel house) for four wheel drive vehicles.

qa_pairs.question: Which section addresses glass fiber reinforced plastic part repair for damaged corners on trunk lids?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 41-012 addresses glass fiber reinforced plastic part repair for damaged corners on trunk lids.

qa_pairs.question: What are the section numbers for engine carrier front left replacement with and without wheel house?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 41-104 covers engine carrier front left (with wheel house) replacement, and section 41-106 covers engine carrier front section and center section, front, left (with wheel house) replacement.
